evidence: African Head Charge's records were released on On-U Sound from 1981, the label Adrian Sherwood founded to release his own productions. Wikipedia's On-U Sound entry lists them among the label's acts, and this map's African Head Charge record already named On-U in its `labels` field without an edge.

later.title: My Life in a Hole in the Ground

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Listen for the label's working method rather than a band sound: layered hand percussion at the centre, and Sherwood's mixing desk doing the rest, with echo and dropouts applied the way Jamaican dub engineers applied them.

explanation.age13: On-U Sound was Adrian Sherwood's own record label in London. African Head Charge was one of its acts: percussion players plus Sherwood at the mixing desk, released on his label from 1981.
explanation.adult: On-U Sound worked more like a production house than a conventional label, and African Head Charge shows why: a project name for whoever Sherwood gathered around Bonjo Iyabinghi Noah's percussion, released on Sherwood's own label. The edge makes visible a relationship both records already stated.
